Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000345": The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000341": As of 2025-04-22, the indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000154": The search indexer relies on the catalog service for product documents, so if the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down.  (about: indexer, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000114": Cinder owns the indexer.  (about: Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000387" [decision]: As of 2025-05-14, Cinder adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000349": As of 2025-04-24, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000108": Team Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000272": As of 2025-03-20, the image resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000269" [constraint]: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000360": As of 2025-05-07, Marcus has the Boreal pager, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000001": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000371": As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, not Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000041": feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000390": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000279": As of 2025-03-20, the reporting service is owned by the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000321": The catalog service calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the catalog service.  (about: image resizer, catalog service)

But wait — the correction changes "Cinder owns the indexer" to "Atlas owns the indexer". The handover effective date is 2025-05-20. New content: "As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder." That's fine.
